# Office of the Historian - U.S. Department of State

> The Office of the Historian provides authoritative declassified documents, biographical records, and comprehensive research resources on U.S. diplomatic history and foreign relations.

This site serves scholars, researchers, policymakers, and the public with access to the Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) series—the official documentary history of U.S. foreign policy. It also maintains extensive databases on State Department personnel, diplomatic travel, and country-specific relations spanning centuries of American diplomatic engagement.

## Key Topics

- Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS)
- Declassified Documents
- Diplomatic History
- State Department History
- U.S. Foreign Policy
- Secretaries of State
- Cold War History
- International Relations
- Diplomatic Relations

- Presidential Travel
- Bilateral Relations
- Declassification Policy

- U.S. Ambassadors

## Historical Documents & FRUS Series

- [Historical Documents - Office of the Historian](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments): Main portal for Foreign Relations of the United States documents
- [About the Foreign Relations Series](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/about-frus): Overview and explanation of FRUS series mandate and structure
- [History of the Foreign Relations Series](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus-history): Historical overview of FRUS series development and declassification policy
- [Status of the Series](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/status-of-the-series): Publication status and declassification progress for FRUS volumes
- [Quarterly Releases](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/quarterly-releases): Schedule and archive of quarterly FRUS document releases
- [Ebooks](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/ebooks): FRUS ebooks in EPUB and Mobi formats for digital access

## Country Relations & Bilateral History

- [Countries - Office of the Historian](https://history.state.gov/countries): Directory of U.S. diplomatic relations by country
- [Archives - Countries](https://history.state.gov/countries/archives): Research guide to foreign archives and diplomatic records

## Department History & Leadership

- [Biographies of the Secretaries of State](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/people/secretaries): Biographical directory of all U.S. Secretaries of State
- [Principal Officers and Chiefs of Mission](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/people/principals-chiefs): Historical database of State Department officials and ambassadors
- [World War I and the Department](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/wwi): State Department role during World War I with archival documents
- [U.S. Diplomatic Couriers](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/diplomatic-couriers): History of U.S. Diplomatic Courier Service and operations
- [Buildings](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/buildings): Historical timeline of State Department buildings and locations

## Diplomatic Travel & Foreign Visits

- [Travels of the Secretary](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/travels/secretary): Records of Secretary of State diplomatic travel and foreign trips
- [Travels of the President](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/travels/president): Historical database of U.S. Presidential foreign travel records
- [Visits by Foreign Leaders](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/visits): Chronological records of foreign leader visits to the United States

## Research Tools & Resources

- [Tags - Office of the Historian](https://history.state.gov/tags): Subject taxonomy for indexing U.S. foreign relations history

## Optional

- [Latest News - Office of the Historian](https://history.state.gov): Homepage for Office of the Historian with latest news and updates
- [Conferences](https://history.state.gov/conferences): Archive of scholarly conferences on diplomatic history
